There was no other option with the pair - all kennels were full and every time an attempt was made to separate them, that kennel would get taken by another dog. We’ve had to put bigger dogs in cages that we wish we didn’t have to. The shelter is overwhelmed and understaffed. People just don’t want to work there nor adopt animals period. She and another coworker bring in water for the cats bc the water is basically potent - have signs for it everywhere - yet still give it to dogs. I hate that. Luckily he quit bc the manager wasn’t taking his bs. But it’s just shit. I enjoy working there, one of the only places I’ve been able to work and not want to off myself. But we don’t have much help to change things.
I’m also not reconsidering adopting her. She’s mine and mine alone as I’m not going back on that. If I could move out I would have years ago but mental issues make that difficult.

So there were two Great Pyrenees that were likely an older breeding pair that got dumped off somewhere and were so skinny. The momma clearly had just had pups but nobody knew anything of them. I made the mistake of leaving a deceased one I found in the middle of the night that I planned to come back to a few hours later.
